Package com.example.releasethekraken.model

Class NotificationRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.releasethekraken.model.NotificationRepository
public class NotificationRepository extends Object
Repository responsible for sending, logging, and retrieving notifications from Firestore. This class belongs to the model layer and contains no UI logic. It manages notification data, handling fetching, updating, and storing notifications from Firebase Firestore, acting as an abstraction layer between the data source and UI components.

      public void declineInvitation(String entrantId, String eventId, String notificationId, NotificationRepository.CompletionCallback callback)
      Validates and declines an invitation, updating Firestore using a WriteBatch. If the invitation was for a winning spot, it triggers a replacement selection.
      Parameters:
      entrantId - The ID of the entrant.
      eventId - The ID of the event.
      notificationId - The ID of the notification.
      callback - The callback to handle the operation result.
